title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: A square and a triangle have equal perimeters. The lengths of the three sides of the triangle are \(6.2\) cm, \(8.3\) cm, and \(9.5\) cm. The area of the square, in square centimeters, is

solutions.text:
The triangle’s perimeter is \(6.2 + 8.3 + 9.5 = 24\) cm, so the square also has perimeter \(24\) cm.

The square’s side is \(\dfrac{24}{4} = 6\) cm, so its area is \(6^2 = 36 \text{ cm}^2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Add the triangle’s three sides to get the common perimeter
The square’s side is one fourth of its perimeter
